Subsidy eligibility needs verification

PM E-DRIVE e-two-wheeler support runs to 31 March 2028, subject to approved model, advanced battery, ₹1.5 lakh ex-factory ceiling, registration, e-voucher and available funds. Current cap: lower of ₹2,500/kWh, ₹5,000 or 15% of ex-factory price. A listing price alone cannot establish eligibility.
